name: Dipolog City Marathon 2026
short_description: A multi-distance road race (42.195/21.1/10/5 km) held in Dipolog City, Philippines, on October 4, 2026.
ai_summary: The Dipolog City Marathon 2026 is scheduled for October 4, 2026, in Dipolog City, Zamboanga del Norte, Philippines, with the venue centered at Sunset Boulevard. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10K, and a 5K, catering to a range of runner abilities. It is organized by the Dipolog City LGU. Registration status has not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (5K, 10K, half marathon, full marathon) suit different runner levels
Scenic venue location at Sunset Boulevard, Dipolog City
Organized by the local city government (Dipolog City LGU)
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
